simple.meaning: יִשְׁבּוֹ בְּנֹב (Yishbôw bᵉ-Nôb) is a Hebrew word meaning “Jishbo-be-Nob , a Philistine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

definitions.full: H3430. Yishbo Benob בְנֹב ישׁבו Kt, בְנֹב יִשׁבּי Qr, proper name, masculine a gigantic Philistine 2Sam 21:16 ; but read בְנֹב וַיֵּשְׁבוּ and they dwelt in Gob , and translated to 21:15 We Dr Bu.
definitions.rootNote: from 3427 and 5011 , with a pronominal suffix and a preposition interposed; his dwelling (is) in Nob;
